title: 박물관 매표소: 표 사고, 가방 맡겨 두기
objective: You can buy a ticket, ask about discounts and rentals, and follow staff instructions that use -어/아 두다.
summary: A short conversation at a museum ticket counter.
setting: The ticket counter in the lobby of a museum.

task.title: Use the ticket office language
task.line: Read the dialogue and word list again, then answer each question in the form it asks for.

words.meaning: to get a discount; a discount applies
words.exampleMeaning: Can I get a discount with this card too?

words.meaning: to rent, to borrow (from a place, formal)
words.exampleMeaning: Can I rent a stroller too?

words.meaning: to leave something with someone for safekeeping
words.exampleMeaning: I left my coat at the information desk.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요. 특별전 표를 사려고 하는데요. 성인 한 명, 학생 한 명이요.
dialogue.meaning: Hello. I'd like to buy tickets for the special exhibition. One adult and one student.

dialogue.korean: 네. 학생은 할인이 돼요. 학생증 좀 보여 주시겠어요?
dialogue.meaning: Sure. Students get a discount. Could you show me the student ID?

dialogue.korean: 여기 있어요. 그리고 오디오 가이드도 빌릴 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Here it is. And can we borrow an audio guide too?

dialogue.korean: 네, 영어로도 있어요. 대여하실 때 신분증을 맡겨 두셔야 해요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, there's one in English too. When you rent it, you need to leave your ID with us.

dialogue.korean: 알겠어요. 아, 가방이 좀 큰데 들고 들어가도 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Okay. Oh, my bag is kind of big. Can I take it in with me?

dialogue.korean: 큰 가방은 안 돼요. 1층 물품 보관함에 넣어 두세요.
dialogue.meaning: Big bags aren't allowed. Please put it in a locker on the 1st floor.

dialogue.korean: 네. 그런데 중간에 나갔다가 다시 들어올 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: Okay. And can we go out in the middle and come back in?

dialogue.korean: 네, 표가 있으면 오늘은 다시 들어오실 수 있어요. 표는 버리지 마시고 잘 챙겨 두세요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, with your ticket you can come back in today. Don't throw it away. Keep it with you.

exercises: Fill in the blanks with the verb + -어/아 두세요: ① 전시실에서는 휴대폰 소리가 나면 안 되니까 무음으로 ____. (하다) ② 주말에는 사람이 많으니까 표를 미리 ____. (사다)
Choose the right word: ① 오디오 가이드를 (대여하고 / 할인하고) 싶어요. ② 어린이는 (할인이 / 관람이) 돼서 표가 더 싸요. ③ 오디오 가이드를 빌리려면 (특별전 / 신분증)을 맡겨야 해요.
Answer in English based on the dialogue: ① What does the visitor leave to borrow an audio guide? ② Where should the big bag go? ③ What does the visitor need to come back in today?
Write it in Korean using 대여하다: At the ticket office, you want to ask if you can borrow a wheelchair (휠체어).
answers: ① 해 두세요 ② 사 두세요
① 대여하고 ② 할인이 ③ 신분증
① An ID card ② In the locker on the 1st floor ③ The ticket
휠체어를 대여할 수 있어요? (휠체어 대여할 수 있어요? / 휠체어를 대여할 수 있을까요?)
